description:
Free, offline-first focus workspace: pomodoro timers with automatic breaks, sticky notes, habits, tasks.

Nerva by Bytical is a persistent focus workspace for deep work. Pomodoro timers with automatic breaks that survive sleep and reboot, floating sticky markdown notes, a year-long habit heatmap, tasks, world clocks and an optional AI assistant with your own key. Offline-first, no account, Apache-2.0.
Nerva by Bytical v0.1.17
Fixed
- Desktop layout adapts to the window. Sidebar and notes widths you drag are now fitted to the current window, so the Focus stage always keeps at least 420px. Below roughly 1100px the layout stacks: sidebar and timers on top, notes full-width underneath. Previously a wide saved layout squeezed the centre pane to a sliver on smaller screens.
- Habit detail card no longer clips. The analytics sheet (streak, misses in a row, best, 30 days, heatmap) opened inside the sidebar and was cut off at its edge; it now opens centred over the whole window on desktop and as a full-width bottom sheet on the phone. The four stat tiles wrap to two columns when the sheet is narrow.
- Google Play. Nerva Mobile is live in closed beta on Google Play; this build carries the matching Play version code.
Downloads
- Linux (Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04, Fedora, etc.) — .AppImage (portable) or .deb / .rpm · also yay -S nerva-desktop-bin, snap install nerva
- Windows 10 / 11 — .msi (installer) or -setup.exe (NSIS) · winget submission awaiting approval
- Android 7+ (Nerva Mobile) — Nerva_x.y.z_android.apk (sideload; attached after the desktop builds). Installs separately from v0.1.14; keep the legacy app to retain its data. No automatic import.
- Direct links that always point at the latest build: https://nerva.bytical.ai/#downloads
Verifying the Windows build
Installers are signed with the Bytical self-signed certificate.
The public bytical-codesign.crt
is available for inspecting the signing identity. A self-signed
certificate does not establish public-CA trust or SmartScreen
reputation; Windows may still show an unrecognized-app warning.
If Nerva helps you focus, a ⭐ on this repo and a rating (Settings → Feedback in the app, or https://nerva.bytical.ai/#feedback) go a long way.
